claims.text: A nondopaminergic selective inverse agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor; can be used to treat psychosis (hallucinations, delusions) in Parkinson disease dementia
claims.quote: Pimavanserin, a nondopaminergic selective inverse agonist of the serotonin 5-HT-2A receptor, can be used to treat psychosis (hallucinations, delusions) in patients with Parkinson disease dementia.

claims.text: In dementia with Lewy bodies, traditional antipsychotics, even at very low doses, tend to acutely worsen extrapyramidal symptoms and are best avoided
